add.k: A Department of Damage Control field agent
st: Agent Foster backs Damage Control's takeover of Toomes's salvage job, tells him not to overextend himself, and is punched for it.
Foster helps arrest Peter Parker at home, then questions him with Agent Cleary over Mysterio's death in London.

files.notes: Credited 'Agent Foster' in both films. Lines confirmed in the Homecoming transcript ('Maybe next time, don't overextend yourself'); his No Way Home line 'Absolutely' is from the wiki (subtitles drop it). Filed T: in No Way Home he arrests and questions Peter for Damage Control, as Agent Cleary (T) does; in Homecoming he only clashes with Toomes. Group 'Damage Control' is named on screen.

add.k: The principal of Midtown School of Science and Technology
add.tm: Midtown School of Science and Technology
st: Principal Morita sends Peter to detention for skipping class, then later calls him a good kid and lets him go with a second chance.

files.notes: Credited 'Principal Morita'. Lines confirmed in transcript ('Parker, my office.', 'Peter, you're a good kid and you're a smart kid'). Only mentioned in No Way Home's extended cut, so no step there. The wiki's Liz send-off scene could not be confirmed and is left out.

add.k: A salvage worker in Toomes's crew
st: Randy tells Toomes they still hold a Chitauri haul, tracks the lost core to Midtown with Schultz, and is webbed up on the ferry.

files.notes: Credited 'Randy'. The surname Vale is from a Daily Bugle promo ad only, so it is not used. Line confirmed: 'Hey, chief! We have another load from yesterday.' Group follows the app's 'Bestman Salvage' as for Schultz and Brice. Status In custody: Spider-Man webs him to the ferry railing as the FBI arrives.

add.k: A S.A.B.E.R. agent on Fury's space station
st: Dag finds Flerken eggs with Talia, reports the station's failures to Fury, and escapes the failing station inside a Flerken.

files.notes: Credited 'Dag'. Lines confirmed in transcript (speaker tags DAG: 'At best, a one-off pest problem', 'In the end, none of us choose how we transition'). The jump point suggestion is tagged TALIA in the subtitles, so it is not given to Dag. Off-world: he is back on the S.A.B.E.R. station at the end.

add.k: A S.A.B.E.R. agent on Fury's space station
st: Talia works the jump point with Monica, finds strange eggs with Dag, and warns Fury the pods cannot carry the station's 350 crew.

files.notes: Credited 'Talia'. Lines confirmed in transcript (speaker tag TALIA: 'We only have one evacuation bay online... nowhere near enough', 'We're doomed'). The simulation scene with Monica is a deleted scene and is left out.

st: Ty-Rone studies Dar-Benn's band and warns her it grows unstable and that its power could kill her.

files.notes: Credited 'Ty-Rone'. Lines confirmed in transcript (speaker tag TY-RONE: 'this band becomes more unstable', 'it would kill you'). The wiki's claim that he fits the band on her wrist is unconfirmed and left out. Group follows Dar-Benn's 'The Kree Empire'. Survives; At large.

add.k: A monster hunter with thirty-seven kills
st: Azarel chases Jack in the maze, tells Verussa the Bloodstone threw him back, then dies at Elsa's hands in the werewolf's rampage.

files.notes: Credited 'Azarel'. Her one line, 'He grabbed it and it threw him back', has no speaker tag in the subtitles; it answers Verussa's question and comes before Verussa turns to Elsa ('And you?'), so it is neither Verussa's nor Elsa's, and Jack lies stunned; the wiki gives it to Azarel. Kill count 37 is from Verussa's roll call as the wiki matches it. Group uses the app's 'Bloodstone's hunters', as for Ulysses, Verussa and The Monster Hunters.

add.k: A boastful Scottish hunter with fifty-seven kills
st: Jovan chats with Jack before the hunt, attacks Elsa with an axe in the maze, and is burned to death by the monster Ted.

files.notes: Credited 'Jovan'; the special's closed captions tag him JOSHUA, so 'Joshua Jovan' is an alias. Lines confirmed in transcript ('Fifty-seven confirmed kills myself', 'Death is coming for you, lassie!'). Group as for Azarel.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Foster stands with Damage Control as it throws Toomes's crew off the Battle of New York cleanup. When Toomes pleads that he could lose his house, Foster tells him not to overextend himself, and Toomes punches him.
stages.whoA: The salvage boss who punches him
stages.whoB: The Damage Control agent he punches

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Foster serves under Agent Cleary on the Damage Control raid on Peter's home. At the precinct they question Peter together, and Cleary sends him to get Ned a snack.
stages.whoB: A Damage Control agent on his team

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Foster helps arrest Peter at home over the London attack. In the interrogation room he sits with Cleary as Peter says the drones killed Beck and Cleary tells him Nick Fury has been off the planet.
stages.whoA: The teen he arrests and questions
stages.whoB: A Damage Control agent who questions him

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Principal Morita calls Peter to his office and gives him detention. Later he calls Peter in again, tells him he is a good kid and a smart kid, and lets him go with a second chance.
stages.whoA: The student he gives a second chance
stages.whoB: His principal at Midtown

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Randy works on Toomes's salvage crew. After Damage Control takes the job, he points out they still have a load of alien material, and Toomes decides to keep it and go into business.
stages.whoA: His boss, whom he calls chief
stages.whoB: A worker on his crew

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Randy and Schultz carry a scanner into Midtown to track the alien power core Spider-Man took. Later they meet Mac Gargan's men on the Staten Island Ferry together.
stages.whoB: His partner on Toomes's crew

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Spider-Man crashes the weapons deal on the Staten Island Ferry. He webs Randy to the railing, leaving him for the FBI.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who webs him up on the ferry
stages.whoB: A crook he webs up on the ferry

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Randy and Schultz sell Toomes's weapons to Gargan on the Staten Island Ferry. Spider-Man breaks up the deal before it is done.
stages.whoA: The buyer at his ferry deal
stages.whoB: A seller at his ferry deal

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Dag and Talia work the S.A.B.E.R. station with Monica. They find strange pink eggs in a vent and bring them to Fury, then report the failing pods as the station falls apart. Afterward they clear out Monica's desk together.
stages.whoB: Her fellow S.A.B.E.R. agent

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Dag reports to Fury on the eggs and the jump point surges, which keep bringing bad news. Fury has the Flerkens swallow the crew to save them, and later asks Dag how things are after Monica is lost.
stages.whoB: An agent on his station

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Dag works with Monica outside the station as the jump point surges. She goes out alone to read it, which tangles her powers with Carol's and Kamala's. When she is stranded, he mourns her.
stages.whoB: A S.A.B.E.R. agent on her spacewalk

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: On the station, Yusuf gives Dag advice on index funds and saving for retirement. Dag admits he never thought about it, and the two laugh together until another surge hits.
stages.whoA: A visitor who gives him money advice
stages.whoB: An agent he advises on retirement

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Talia brings Fury the eggs and tells him fifteen escape pods cannot save 350 crew. Fury orders her to fill them and find a Plan B, then saves everyone with the Flerkens.
stages.whoB: An agent on his station

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Talia works the jump point with Monica on a spacewalk outside the station. After Monica is stranded in another universe, Talia clears out her desk in sorrow.
stages.whoB: A S.A.B.E.R. agent on her team

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Ty-Rone serves Dar-Benn as she hunts the bands to save Hala. He warns her the band is unstable and the power to relight Hala's sun would kill her, but she refuses to wait.
stages.whoB: Her advisor, who studies the band

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Monica appears on Dar-Benn's ship with Kamala, and Ty-Rone asks what to do about them. On Aladna, Monica blasts Dar-Benn, and Ty-Rone hands his leader back her weapon.
stages.whoB: Dar-Benn's advisor

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Kamala suddenly appears with Monica on Dar-Benn's ship in Carol's place. Ty-Rone tells Dar-Benn they are associates of Captain Marvel and asks what to do with them.
stages.whoB: Dar-Benn's advisor

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Azarel chases Jack through the maze. When the Bloodstone throws him back, she tells Verussa, exposing him as a monster, and then watches him turn into a werewolf.
stages.whoB: A hunter who chases and exposes him

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Both hunt the monster for the Bloodstone. When Elsa breaks free during the werewolf's rampage, Azarel attacks her with a chain hammer, and Elsa kills her with a sword.
stages.whoB: A hunter she kills

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Azarel answers Verussa's call to hunt for the Bloodstone. She tells Verussa the stone threw Jack back, then masks up beside her as Verussa forces Jack to change.
stages.whoA: The widow who runs the hunt
stages.whoB: A hunter at her ceremony

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Jovan chats warmly with Jack before the ceremony, boasting of his kills. Jack draws the right to enter the maze first, and Jovan groans at his luck.
stages.whoA: A friendly rival in the hunt
stages.whoB: A boastful rival in the hunt

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Jovan runs into Elsa in the maze and attacks her with an axe. She flips him and takes the axe, and he swears death is coming for her.
stages.whoA: The hunter he swears to kill
stages.whoB: A hunter who attacks her with an axe

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Jovan hunts the monster through the maze to win the Bloodstone. Ted bursts out of the bushes, grabs his head and burns him to death.
stages.whoB: A hunter he kills

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Jovan comes to Verussa's ceremony for Ulysses, where she counts his 57 kills. He joins the pledge and follows her rules for the hunt.
stages.whoA: The widow who runs the hunt
stages.whoB: A hunter at her ceremony
